openspec/changes/add-time-sliders-to-location-cards/tasks.md:164:- [ ] 8.2 Verify `pnpm --filter @time-zones/client typecheck`, `pnpm --filter @time-zones/client lint`, `pnpm --filter @time-zones/client test` and `pnpm run build`, one at a time. Then run the whole E2E suite once, alone and not in the background: `pnpm --filter @time-zones/client test:bdd` (bddgen plus every Playwright project, including `view-contract-cards`).
